notes.title: Metro Simulator 2 has been released from Early Access!
notes.content:
Metro Simulator 2 has been released today!

We released the update to improve overall quality of the game. Here's what was changed:
[list]
[*] Noticeably improved passengers' behavior: now they don't get stuck near pillars and don't walk on one place without moving.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused passengers not to spawn on the stations where the player has been before.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused passengers not to leave the train after changing route on terminal station.
[*] Fixed situations that could cause red light to be displayed when it shouldn't have.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41417136/8a02a8564c30e4e77fa41270ae0b8c34ebf16201.png[/img]

How about joining our Discord server?
Here's the link: http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap

And a page on Twitter: https://twitter.com/kishmishstudio

notes.title: Patch 1.5.3 is available!
notes.content:
Patch 1.5.3 which fixes lots of known issues is available on Steam. Our main task now is to fix bugs that can prevent you from playing with comfort.

Changelist:
- Fixed railroad switches animations
- The running line on auto-informer display now only scrolls if the text doesn't fit into the screen
- Fixed arrow on the route sheet on Kitay-Gorod station (towards center) in Free Mode and in 4th scenario
- Fixed a bug which made it hard to change the position of railroad switch on the second track of VDNkH towards the dead end
- Mouse sensitivity is now equal in driving mode and walking mode
- Fixed a problem that sometimes caused no reward for announcing stations in time
- Improved Auto-informer logics in scenarios #2 and #4 (route on the route sheet is automatically set when needed)
- Fixed navigation banners on Leninskiy Prospect.
- If you set the schedule soon to 1:00 AM, when Metro closes, the time in route sheet no longer jumps to morning.
- Fixed rare problems in traffic light system.

*Screenshot by ER2T-7217 from Steam Community.

notes.title: A new update is available!
notes.content:
Another patch for Metro Simulator 2 is here!

Changelog:
- Indication of distance between you and next traffic light has been added under the next speed limit indicator.
- Speed limit indicator now flashes when you pass a traffic light so that it's easier to notice when the speed limit changes.

- If any language except for Russian is selected, station names are now easier to read in the main menu.
- Adjusted logics of scoring points in Train transfer scenario so that required score is not negative.
- Adjusted logics of some lamps in Nomernoy cabin.
- When train approaches speed limit, it automatically disables acceleration circuits, but it takes some time. This time was shortened to better match the real experience.

notes.title: The first patch with numerous fixes is available!
notes.content:
A patch has been released on Steam, fixing the following issues:
- Fixed Nomernoy sound when accelerating at a slow rate
- Switching between Fullscreen and Windowed mode now works instantly in the pause menu settings
- Added sound for displacement brake on Nomernoy
- Red lights now flash above the doors on Oka train when announcing the next station and closing them
- Fixed emergency brake force on Nomernoy
- Fixed passengers' sitting points on Nomernoy so that passengers won't have their legs going through the seats
- Fixed independent brake crane sounds
- Fixed a problem that could prevent you from disabling Bloom in settings
- Now, if you lose, scenario restarts instead of throwing you out back to main menu
- Fixed Contact rail lamp on Oka train
- Fixed the achievement for transferring 1000 passengers. Before, it was completable even without transferring any passengers
- Message about cancelling emergency brakes can now be dismissed by re-enabling reverser
- Fixed lighting issue on ammeter in Nomernoy
- By default, Motion Blur is now off
- Fixed multiple errors that could lock up scenarios
- Other minor improvements

As you can see, now we're concentrated on fixing known bugs. In the next update, we'd like to add the indication of distance between you and the next traffic light.

If you found a bug in the game, please report it to us. Thanks in advance!

notes.title: More news about scenarios
notes.content:
We're now almost finished with the two tutorial scenarios. All bugs that were found in them are fixed, but we're still testing them to make sure we won't find more over time. After that, we'll concentrate on two regular scenarios. They are already playable, but they have some bugs which we need to fix. It shouldn't take long.

Recently, we made a small feature: lights on Oka train now dim when you enter the station and get back to bright mode when you leave it.

Added achievements to the game, eight of them to be precise.

Now we'll try to implement mirrors on stations. Performance problems are likely, so they will be optional and disabled by default.

On the previous week, we sent in-game texts for translation to the languages which are used in countries with the largest number of players added the game to their wishlist. Also, we're starting our work on Early Access trailer.

In general, not much work is left to be done until Early Access release. We'll announce the precise date later.

notes.title: About Nomernoy's systems
notes.content:
We're hardly working on scripting the "Nomernoy" train, and today we'll tell you about the things we have already implemented and what we are working on now.

[h2]Driver's controller and acceleration system[/h2]

We have already spoke about the global re-work of train controls in Metro Simulator 2, which gave us a possibility to create individual control systems. Oka got an optimized system, Russia got a re-worked system of acceleration with a new mechanism of driver's controller. Now, Nomernoy has got an individual mechanism - rheostat controller.
To be short, rheostat controller is a mechanism which allows the train to accelerate and brake fluently. It has 36 position for acceleration and 18 for braking. The higher the position, the more intensive the train accelerates or slows down.
Positions for accelerations serve two purposes depending on from which positions we switched it - making the train accelerate faster (when moving it up) and making it accelerate slower (when moving it down).
Decelerating works in two options - Bypass, when you need to manually move the rheostat controller between T-1 and T-1a states, and automatic in T-2 state, when rheostat controller automatically decelerates.

[h2]Pneumatic system[/h2]

Pneumatics have an individual place in train's technical composition, but we haven't been able to implement them up to a recent time. But, when we decided to make Nomernoy, we decided to make it due to absolute necessity of this system in this train.
The main control of pneumatic train in Nomernoy train is the independent brakes 013 (КрМ) It has 7 positions to adjust braking force, with the last position being emergency brake. It's initialized by the uncoupling cap, and you won't be able to drive the train without it. Pneumatic system is connected to ARS (Automatic Speed Control System). If you drive past the red traffic light or start driving without allowing frequency without Vigilance pedal, brake system will be automatically set to Emergency position, and the train will stop.

We'll share more details about the development while we are working on the game. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist in order not to skip other news about the game and its Early Access release in the first half of this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41417136/4e45324948a06273f27d1b61a26af8b044279b47.jpg[/img]
